versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: [In those days mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightnings, and of the lights, and the judgements they execute (lit. ‘their judgement’): and they lighten for a blessing or a curse as the Lord of Spirits willeth.
verses.text_hr: [U one su dane moje oči vidjele tajne munja i svjetala te sudove koje izvršavaju, doslovno „njihov sud“: one svijetle na blagoslov ili prokletstvo kako hoće Gospodar duhova.

verses.text_en: And there I saw the secrets of the thunder, and how when it resounds above in the heaven, the sound thereof is heard, and he caused me to see the =judgements= executed on the earth, whether they be for well-being and blessing, or for a curse, according to the word of the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Ondje sam vidio tajne groma: kako se, kad odjekne gore na nebu, čuje njegov zvuk. Pokazao mi je =sudove= koji se izvršavaju na zemlji, bilo za dobrobit i blagoslov bilo za prokletstvo, prema riječi Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en: And after that all the secrets of the lights and lightnings were shown to me, and they lighten for blessing and for satisfying.]
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga pokazane su mi sve tajne svjetala i munja, a one svijetle radi blagoslova i okrjepe.]
